image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a rough, wet rocky substrate. The organism features a distinct oval shape with a central row of eight overlapping, greyish-white calcareous plates surrounded by a dark, textured, leathery girdle. Small green algae and barnacles are visible on the surrounding rock.
